name: spendbar
description: Per-project Claude Code + Codex spend tracking, grouped by project and model family.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test tests-ts/*.test.mjs && npm run test:python
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run parity -- --final && npm run test:goldens && npm run test:oracle && npm run test:pure && npm run test:allowlist && npm run test:spikes && npm run test:mcp-spike && npm run verify:real-client-evidence
scripts.test:mcp-spike: node spikes/mcp/supply-chain.test.mjs && node spikes/mcp/isolate.test.mjs && node spikes/mcp/conformance.test.mjs && node spikes/mcp/strict-json.test.mjs && node spikes/mcp/decide.test.mjs && node spikes/mcp/real-client/normalize.test.mjs && node spikes/mcp/real-client/classify.test.mjs
scripts.verify:real-client-evidence: node spikes/mcp/verify-evidence.mjs > /dev/null && echo 'recorded T-009 evidence verified offline'
scripts.test:oracle: python3 tests/oracle/verify.py && python3 tests/oracle/build.py --regen-check && python3 tests/oracle/mutation_check.py
scripts.test:spikes: node --test spikes/lifecycle.test.mjs spikes/locking/publish.test.mjs spikes/locking/lock.race.test.mjs spikes/locking/portlock.test.mjs spikes/locking/bootstrap.test.mjs spikes/socket-cred/auth.test.mjs
